pairs.target: qù fēnshuǐ tái de lù bǐ tǎ wéi yǐwéi de duǎn .
pairs.english: The route to the water-dividing platform was shorter than Tavi had expected.
pairs.hanzi: 去分水台的路比塔维以为的短。

pairs.target: chū le xuégōng běimén , yán shuǐqú zǒu bàngè shíchén , báiqiáng jiù luòdào le jiǎoxià .
pairs.english: An hour's walk along the channel beyond the school's north gate brought the white walls below their feet.
pairs.hanzi: 出了学宫北门，沿水渠走半个时辰，白墙就落到了脚下。

pairs.target: qú lǐ de shuǐ hé tāmen bìngpái zǒu , gé zhe shíbì tīngbújiàn duōshǎo shēngyīn , dào le zhuǎnwānchù , què tūrán xiǎng dé xiàng zhěngpiàn shānpō dōu zài xiàyǔ .
pairs.english: The water traveled beside them, almost inaudible through the stone wall, until at a bend it suddenly sounded like rain across the whole hillside.
pairs.hanzi: 渠里的水和他们并排走，隔着石壁听不见多少声音，到了转弯处，却突然响得像整片山坡都在下雨。

pairs.target: tā zài qiáotóu tíng le yíxià .
pairs.english: He paused at the bridgehead.
pairs.hanzi: 他在桥头停了一下。

pairs.target: yǎnqián shì yízuò qì zài shānyāo de shítái .
pairs.english: Before him stood a stone platform built into the mountainside.
pairs.hanzi: 眼前是一座砌在山腰的石台。

pairs.target: shàngyóu de shuǐ xiān luò jìn kuān chí , chí wěi bìng páikāi zhe liǎnggè shuǐkǒu , gè yǒu yíshàn hòu mù zhá .
pairs.english: Upstream water first fell into a broad basin, with two outlets side by side at its far end, each with a thick wooden sluice gate.
pairs.hanzi: 上游的水先落进宽池，池尾并排开着两个水口，各有一扇厚木闸。

pairs.target: yìtiáo qú rào shān wǎng tóng jiē chéng qù , lìng yìtiáo jià zài gāogāode shí dūn shàng , shēnxiàng wù zhōng de shān xì .
pairs.english: One channel wound around the mountain toward Copperstep; the other ran on tall stone piers toward a gap between mountains in the mist.
pairs.hanzi: 一条渠绕山往铜阶城去，另一条架在高高的石墩上，伸向雾中的山隙。

pairs.target: shuǐ cóng zhá dǐ chōngchū , zài qīnghēi de shí miànshàng tānkāi báimò , fānguòqù jiù kànbújiàn le .
pairs.english: Water rushed beneath the gates, spreading white foam on dark stone before spilling out of sight.
pairs.hanzi: 水从闸底冲出，在青黑的石面上摊开白沫，翻过去就看不见了。

pairs.target: yīwén cóng hòumiàn pèng le pèng tā de bāo . " bié zhàn zhèér , hòumiàn guòbùlái . "
pairs.english: Iven nudged his bag from behind. “Don't stand here. Nobody can get past.”
pairs.hanzi:
伊文从后面碰了碰他的包。
“别站这儿，后面过不来。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gǎnjǐn wǎngqiánzǒu . tā bǎ shuǐhú huàn dào lìngyìbiān , gēnzhe duìwu guòqiáo .
pairs.english: Tavi hurried forward, shifted his water flask to the other side, and followed the group across the bridge.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维赶紧往前走。他把水壶换到另一边，跟着队伍过桥。

pairs.target: qiáomiàn zhī gòu liǎnggè rén bìngjiān , lángān què hěn hòu , měi gēn zhùjiǎo dōu bāo zhe tiě .
pairs.english: The bridge was only wide enough for two abreast, but the railings were thick, every post foot wrapped in iron.
pairs.hanzi: 桥面只够两个人并肩，栏杆却很厚，每根柱脚都包着铁。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī bǎ xuéshēng lǐngdào chíbiān yídào huángxiàn hòu , shùwán rén , cái ràng tāmen qǔchū mùbǎn hé zhǐ .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey led the students behind a yellow line by the basin, counted them, then let them take out boards and paper.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师把学生领到池边一道黄线后，数完人，才让他们取出木板和纸。

pairs.target: gàoshì yāoqiú dài de jiùshì zhèxiē , lìng yǒu shuǐ hé yíkuài néng lěng zhe chī de bǐng .
pairs.english: These were what the notice required, along with water and a flatbread that could be eaten cold.
pairs.hanzi: 告示要求带的就是这些，另有水和一块能冷着吃的饼。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi de huíxìn yǐjīng zài chū ménqián tóujìn xuégōng de xìnxiāng , bāo lǐ kōng chū yìxiǎokuài dìfāng , tā duō fàng le bànkuài bǐng .
pairs.english: Tavi had posted his reply in the school's letterbox before leaving; the space left in his bag let him pack an extra half-flatbread.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维的回信已经在出门前投进学宫的信箱，包里空出一小块地方，他多放了半块饼。

pairs.target: " xiān huà shuǐ wǎng nǎér zǒu . " wéi lǎoshī shuō , " búyòng huà dé hǎokàn , liǎnggè chūkǒu bié shǎo yígè . "
pairs.english: “First draw where the water goes,” Instructor Vey said. “It needn't be pretty. Just don't miss either outlet.”
pairs.hanzi: “先画水往哪儿走。”维老师说，“不用画得好看，两个出口别少一个。”

pairs.target: fùzé dàilù de qú gōng shì gè shòu nánrén , màoyán shī le yìquān .
pairs.english: Their guide, a thin channel worker, had a wet ring around his hat brim.
pairs.hanzi: 负责带路的渠工是个瘦男人，帽檐湿了一圈。

pairs.target: tā zhàn zài huángxiàn wài , yòng chánggān diǎn xiàng chíkǒu .
pairs.english: He stood beyond the yellow line, pointing a long pole at the basin inlet.
pairs.hanzi: 他站在黄线外，用长杆点向池口。

pairs.target: shuǐ jìn kuān chí yǐhòu mànxiàlái , shā huì chén zài dǐxià ; liǎngbiān de zhá tiáo liúliàng , jīntiān yào qīng wǎng dōng nàtiáo qú de jī shā .
pairs.english: Water slowed in the wide basin, letting sand settle to the bottom; the gates on either side regulated flow. Today they were clearing sediment from the eastbound channel.
pairs.hanzi: 水进宽池以后慢下来，砂会沉在底下；两边的闸调流量，今天要清往东那条渠的积砂。

pairs.target: " nàbiān qù nǎér ? " mǐlā wèn .
pairs.english: “Where does that one go?” Mira asked.
pairs.hanzi: “那边去哪儿？”米拉问。

pairs.target: " bái jiǎ . guò le shān xì hái défēn jǐhuí , zuìyuǎn de shuǐ dào bùliǎo chéngmén , xiān ràng yánlù de tián hē le . "
pairs.english: “Whitecape. It divides several more times beyond the gap. The farthest water won't reach the city gates: fields along the way drink it first.”
pairs.hanzi: “白岬。过了山隙还得分几回，最远的水到不了城门，先让沿路的田喝了。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shùnzhe gāo qú wàng guòqù .
pairs.english: Tavi looked along the elevated channel.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维顺着高渠望过去。

pairs.target: tā yìzhí juéde shān yǔ shān zhījiān zhǐyǒu kōng chù , xiànzài cái kànchū , wùlǐ hái cáng zhe yídào gèng xì de xiàn , tiēzhe duìmiàn de shānyāo wǎng xiàluò .
pairs.english: He'd always thought only empty space lay between mountains; now he saw another, finer line hidden in the mist, descending along the opposite mountainside.
pairs.hanzi: 他一直觉得山与山之间只有空处，现在才看出，雾里还藏着一道更细的线，贴着对面的山腰往下落。

pairs.target: chí páng yǒu kuài kè zhe liǎngzuò chéng huī de shíbēi , yìbiān yǐjīng chángmǎn lǜtái .
pairs.english: Beside the basin stood a stone tablet bearing two city emblems, one side already thick with green moss.
pairs.hanzi: 池旁有块刻着两座城徽的石碑，一边已经长满绿苔。

pairs.target: yīwén dūn zài bēi qián , ná zhǐ dǎngzhù fēilái de shuǐ diǎn .
pairs.english: Iven crouched before it, shielding it from spray with his paper.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文蹲在碑前，拿纸挡住飞来的水点。

pairs.target: tā rènshi nà liǎnggè huījì , què méi rènchū xiàmiàn mó qiǎn de niánfèn .
pairs.english: He knew the two emblems but couldn't read the worn date below.
pairs.hanzi: 他认识那两个徽记，却没认出下面磨浅的年份。

pairs.target: mǐlā huà dào dìèrgè chūkǒu , fāxiàn zhǐ búgòu kuān , biàn ràng shuǐqú guǎi le gè jíwān .
pairs.english: Mira reached the second outlet, found her paper too narrow, and gave the channel a sharp bend.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉画到第二个出口，发现纸不够宽，便让水渠拐了个急弯。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kàn le kàn zìjǐ de , yě méishèng duōshǎo dìfāng . tā bǎ mùbǎn zhuǎnguò lái , cóng bèimiàn jiēzhe huà .
pairs.english: Tavi checked his own; he hadn't much space left either. He turned his board over and continued on the back.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看了看自己的，也没剩多少地方。他把木板转过来，从背面接着画。

pairs.target: tāmen hái méi huà wán , yígè chuān huīsè duǎn wàiyī de rén dài zhe liǎngmíng gōngrén shàng le shítái .
pairs.english: Before they finished, a man in a short grey coat came onto the platform with two workers.
pairs.hanzi: 他们还没画完，一个穿灰色短外衣的人带着两名工人上了石台。

pairs.target: lái rén xiàng qú gōng zhǎnkāi yìzhāng zhǐ , méi kàn xuéshēng .
pairs.english: The newcomer unfolded a paper for the channel worker without looking at the students.
pairs.hanzi: 来人向渠工展开一张纸，没看学生。

pairs.target: " bùnéng xiànzài guān . xiàmiàn de rǎnfáng hái méi fàng wán zhè yì chí . "
pairs.english: “You can't close it now. The dye works below haven't emptied this batch yet.”
pairs.hanzi: “不能现在关。下面的染坊还没放完这一池。”

pairs.target: qú gōng bǎ chánggān kào shàng lángān , zǒu guòqù .
pairs.english: The channel worker leaned his pole against the rail and went over.
pairs.hanzi: 渠工把长杆靠上栏杆，走过去。

pairs.target: " zuórì jiù sòng guò xìn . zài tuō , ní dōu dào zhá jiǎo le . "
pairs.english: “We sent word yesterday. Delay again and the mud will reach the foot of the gate.”
pairs.hanzi: “昨日就送过信。再拖，泥都到闸脚了。”

pairs.target: " xìn dào le chéng shǔ , méi dào rǎnfáng . nǐmen yì shōu shuǐ , xiàmiàn nà chí xǐ dào yíbàn , fú sè jiù xǐ bú jìng le . "
pairs.english: “Word reached the city office, not the dye works. Cut the water halfway through rinsing that vat below and the excess dye won't rinse out.”
pairs.hanzi: “信到了城署，没到染坊。你们一收水，下面那池洗到一半，浮色就洗不净了。”

pairs.target: shuǐshēng hěndà , tāmen bùdébù táigāo shēngyīn .
pairs.english: The water was loud; they had to raise their voices.
pairs.hanzi: 水声很大，他们不得不抬高声音。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tīngjiàn " zuórì ", yòu tīngjiàn " rìluò ", què bù zhīdào zhōngjiān lòudiào le duōshǎo huà .
pairs.english: Tavi heard “yesterday,” then “sunset,” but didn't know how much he'd missed in between.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维听见“昨日”，又听见“日落”，却不知道中间漏掉了多少话。

pairs.target: nàge huī yī rén bǎ zhǐ yā zài bēi shàng , fēng yòu bǎ zhǐ xiānqǐ lái .
pairs.english: The grey-coated man pressed his paper against the tablet, but the wind lifted it again.
pairs.hanzi: 那个灰衣人把纸压在碑上，风又把纸掀起来。

pairs.target: tā yìzhī shǒu àn zhǐ , yìzhī shǒuzhǐ zhe wǎng dōng de qú .
pairs.english: One hand held the paper; the other pointed toward the eastbound channel.
pairs.hanzi: 他一只手按纸，一只手指着往东的渠。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī jiào xuéshēng wǎng lǐ nuó , bǎ tōngdào ràng chūlái . tā yě méiyǒu chāhuà .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey moved the students inward to clear the passage. She didn't interrupt either.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师叫学生往里挪，把通道让出来。她也没有插话。

pairs.target: mǐlā kàn le yíhuìer , xiǎoshēng shuō : " wǒ diē zuì fánrén lái le cái shuō bùnéng tíng . "
pairs.english: After watching a while, Mira said softly, “My dad hates being told things can't stop only after he's arrived.”
pairs.hanzi: 米拉看了一会儿，小声说：“我爹最烦人来了才说不能停。”

pairs.target: " yě bùnéng bǎ yǐjīng xiàshuǐ de bù rēngdiào . " yīwén shuō .
pairs.english: “But you can't throw out cloth already in the water,” Iven said.
pairs.hanzi: “也不能把已经下水的布扔掉。”伊文说。

pairs.target: " wǒ méi shuō rēngdiào . "
pairs.english: “I didn't say throw it out.”
pairs.hanzi: “我没说扔掉。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kàn xiàng chí wěi . liǎngshàn zhá dōu hái kāi zhe , mù zhá shàng de tiě chǐ bèi shuǐqì rùn dé fāliàng .
pairs.english: Tavi looked toward the basin's end. Both gates were still open, the iron teeth on the wooden gates gleaming with moisture.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看向池尾。两扇闸都还开着，木闸上的铁齿被水汽润得发亮。

pairs.target: yuánlái shuǐ wǎng nǎér zǒu , hé shénme shíhòu ràng tā zǒu , shì liǎnghuíshì .
pairs.english: Where water went and when to let it go were two different questions.
pairs.hanzi: 原来水往哪儿走，和什么时候让它走，是两回事。

pairs.target: tā zài tú biān liú le gè kōng , xiǎng děng tīng míngbái zài xiě .
pairs.english: He left a space beside the drawing, wanting to understand before writing more.
pairs.hanzi: 他在图边留了个空，想等听明白再写。

pairs.target: huī yī rén zhuǎnshēn qǔ chǐ shí kànjiàn yīwén , zhēng le yíxià .
pairs.english: The grey-coated man turned for a ruler, saw Iven, and paused in surprise.
pairs.hanzi: 灰衣人转身取尺时看见伊文，怔了一下。

pairs.target: " nǐ yě zài zhèér ? nǐ fùqīn shuō nǐ jìn xuégōng le , wǒ hái yǐwéi yào dào yuèdǐ . "
pairs.english: “You're here too? Your father said you'd entered the school. I thought it wouldn't be until month's end.”
pairs.hanzi: “你也在这儿？你父亲说你进学宫了，我还以为要到月底。”

pairs.target: yīwén zhàn qǐlái , jiào le tā yìshēng liǔxiānshēng . " dìbātiān . "
pairs.english: Iven stood, addressing him as Mr. Liu. “Eighth day.”
pairs.hanzi:
伊文站起来，叫了他一声柳先生。
“第八天。”

pairs.target: liǔxiānshēng diǎndiǎntóu , sìhū hái xiǎng shuō shénme , qú gōng yǐjīng zài lìngyìbiān hǎn tā .
pairs.english: Mr. Liu nodded, seeming about to say more, but the channel worker was already calling from the other side.
pairs.hanzi: 柳先生点点头，似乎还想说什么，渠工已经在另一边喊他。

pairs.target: tā cōngcōng huíqù , liǎnggè rén kāishǐ bǐhuà chídǐ de kuāndù , shēngyīn bǐ gāngcái dī le xiē .
pairs.english: He hurried back; they began gesturing about the basin floor's width, their voices quieter than before.
pairs.hanzi: 他匆匆回去，两个人开始比划池底的宽度，声音比刚才低了些。

pairs.target: " nǐjiā rènshi tā ? " tǎ wéi wèn .
pairs.english: “Your family knows him?” Tavi asked.
pairs.hanzi: “你家认识他？”塔维问。

pairs.target: " tā zài bái jiǎ bàn shuǐlù de shì . wǒ diē tì tóng jiē chéng zài nàbiān chuán wénshū , lái de shíhòu chángzhù wǒjiā . "
pairs.english: “He handles waterway matters in Whitecape. My father carries official correspondence for Copperstep over there. He often stays with us when he visits.”
pairs.hanzi: “他在白岬办水路的事。我爹替铜阶城在那边传文书，来的时候常住我家。”

pairs.target: mǐlā táiqǐ tóu : " nà tā tīng nǐ de ? "
pairs.english: Mira looked up. “So he listens to you?”
pairs.hanzi: 米拉抬起头：“那他听你的？”

pairs.target: yīwén lèng le , suíjí xiào le yìshēng .
pairs.english: Iven blinked, then gave a short laugh.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文愣了，随即笑了一声。

pairs.target: " tā lián wǒ diē dehuà yě bù yídìng tīng . shàng huí tāmen zài wǒjiā chīfàn , chǎo dào cài liáng . "
pairs.english: “He doesn't always listen to my father, either. Last time they ate at our house, they argued until the food went cold.”
pairs.hanzi: “他连我爹的话也不一定听。上回他们在我家吃饭，吵到菜凉。”

pairs.target: " wèishénme ? " " wǒ wàng le . nà pán yú hòulái dōu méi rén chī . "
pairs.english: “Why?” “I've forgotten. Nobody ate the fish afterward.”
pairs.hanzi:
“为什么？”
“我忘了。那盘鱼后来都没人吃。”

pairs.target: mǐlā dītóu shōuqǐ zhǐ , méiyǒu zài wèn .
pairs.english: Mira lowered her head and put away her paper without asking more.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉低头收起纸，没有再问。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bù zhīdào tā shìbushì shēngqì le , yě bù zhīdào yīwén shì zhēnde wàng le , háishì bùxiǎng shuō .
pairs.english: Tavi didn't know whether she was annoyed, or whether Iven had really forgotten or didn't want to say.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维不知道她是不是生气了，也不知道伊文是真的忘了，还是不想说。

pairs.target: tā bǎ bèimiàn de shuǐqú huà dào jìntóu , méiyǒu wǎng nàge kōng lǐ tiān zì .
pairs.english: He finished the channel on the back without adding words in the blank space.
pairs.hanzi: 他把背面的水渠画到尽头，没有往那个空里添字。

pairs.target: línzǒuqián , qú gōng gàosù wéi lǎoshī , xiān qīng xīcè chídǐ , dōng qú děng rǎnfáng bǎ zhè yì chí xǐwán ;
pairs.english: Before they left, the channel worker told Instructor Vey they'd clear the basin's west side first and wait on the east channel until the dye works finished rinsing this batch;
pairs.hanzi: 临走前，渠工告诉维老师，先清西侧池底，东渠等染坊把这一池洗完；

pairs.target: qīng chūlái de shā xiān duī zài táishàng , míngtiān cáinéng yùn .
pairs.english: the cleared sand would be piled on the platform until it could be moved tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 清出来的砂先堆在台上，明天才能运。

pairs.target: huī yī rén zhàn zài pángbiān , yòu wèn le yíbiàn yào děng duōjiǔ , qú gōng shuō tā yě dé xiàqù kàn .
pairs.english: The grey-coated man stood beside him and asked again how long they must wait. The channel worker said he had to go down and look himself.
pairs.hanzi: 灰衣人站在旁边，又问了一遍要等多久，渠工说他也得下去看。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī diǎntóu , lǐng xuéshēng líkāi .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey nodded and led the students away.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师点头，领学生离开。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi huítóu shí , liǎnggè gōngrén yǐjīng juǎnqǐ kùtuǐ , yánzhe chíbiān de shíjiē wǎngxiàzǒu , shǒulǐ de chǎnzǐ hái méiyǒu zhānshuǐ .
pairs.english: When Tavi looked back, two workers had rolled up their trouser legs and were descending the stone steps beside the basin, shovels still dry in their hands.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维回头时，两个工人已经卷起裤腿，沿着池边的石阶往下走，手里的铲子还没有沾水。

pairs.target: huíchéng dào yìkē ǎi sōngxià , duìwu tíngxiàlái chī bǐng .
pairs.english: On the way back, the group stopped under a low pine to eat their bread.
pairs.hanzi: 回程到一棵矮松下，队伍停下来吃饼。

pairs.target: mǐlā zhǎnkāi tú , nágěi yīwén kàn zìjǐ huà búxià de nàge wān .
pairs.english: Mira unfolded her drawing to show Iven the bend she hadn't had room for.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉展开图，拿给伊文看自己画不下的那个弯。

pairs.target: yīwén yòng yíkuài xiǎoshízǐ yāzhù zhǐ jiǎo , zhǐzhe zhēnzhèng de gāo qú shuō , nàlǐ zhìshǎo hái dé wǎngqián shēn zhème yuǎn .
pairs.english: Iven weighted the paper corner with a pebble and pointed to the actual elevated channel, saying it had to extend at least this much farther.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文用一块小石子压住纸角，指着真正的高渠说，那里至少还得往前伸这么远。

pairs.target: tā bǎ tā de shǒu tuīkāi , jiāng liǎngzhāng zhǐ jiē zài yìqǐ .
pairs.english: She pushed his hand aside and joined the two sheets.
pairs.hanzi: 她把他的手推开，将两张纸接在一起。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zuòzài tāmen pángbiān , bāikāi duō dài de bànkuài bǐng , wèn shuí yào .
pairs.english: Sitting beside them, Tavi broke off the extra half-flatbread and asked who wanted some.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维坐在他们旁边，掰开多带的半块饼，问谁要。

pairs.target: liǎnggè rén jīhū tóngshí shēn le shǒu , tā zhǐhǎo zài bāi yícì .
pairs.english: Both reached out almost at once, so he had to break it again.
pairs.hanzi: 两个人几乎同时伸了手，他只好再掰一次。

pairs.target: bǐngxiè luò zài tú shàng de shān xì lǐ , fēng yì chuī , jiù shùnzhe nàtiáo huà wāi de shuǐqú gǔn le xiàqù .
pairs.english: Crumbs fell into the mountain gap on the drawing; a gust rolled them down the crooked channel.
pairs.hanzi: 饼屑落在图上的山隙里，风一吹，就顺着那条画歪的水渠滚了下去。
